'''Andrew Giuliano The Return of the Jedi Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Andrew Giuliano]]
* '''Published:''' May 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Swamp|Dagobah-L-dagobahswamp.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' The Return of the Jedi Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag The Return of the Jedi Deck Giulian.txt |Download]]
